# Vendored goz modules

Source: https://github.com/mustafaahci/goz
Revision: 8c6a7b1562bb1eea46dd67d462805b49b9a1f152 (2026-10-31)
License: MIT; see LICENSE.

Only goz-core and goz-winfs are included. The CLI, upstream daemon, automatic journal creation/resizing, polling supervisor, working-set tuning and elevation installer are not used by Flowtary. Source files are initially unmodified; workspace dependencies are controlled by indexer/Cargo.toml.
